mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 600K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to decreased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strengthening labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter, signaling a supply chain ramp-up, precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturers' growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO growth and SPX returns remains below 0.1 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% annually, indicating strong aggregate demand, is followed by positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy's health boosts investor sentiment.
evidence_refs: fact:GDP and stock market historical relationship
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not positively correlated (p > 0.05) with GDPC1 growth in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Whenever the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is hiked by more than 50 basis points in a single meeting, the surprise tightening predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances following a FEDFUNDS hike > 50bps.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 6%) and high payroll employment growth (PAYEMS > 300K in a month) creates a labor market overheating signal, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to impending inflation concerns.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market and inflation dynamics
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant negative correlation (p > 0.1) between the labor market overheating signal and subsequent SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) increasing by more than 5% year-over-year, signaling strong consumer spending, is always followed by positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence boosts market sentiment.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between RSAFS growth and SPX returns remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.
